;; D19 demonstration, AFTER: the same line clear with capture variables.
;; The label column and the `%` scratch register disappear from the board;
;; ten variables move a whole row at once, and the sentinel row bubbles to
;; the top of the well by REPEAT.  The parameterized ATOMIC sits INSIDE the
;; REPEAT deliberately (decision D9): each cascade step must bind the next
;; row fresh rather than equality-test against the first one.

GOAL
Z

WHITESPACE -

x----------x
x-XX-------x
xXXXXXXXXXXx
x--X-------x
xXXXXXXXXXXx
x-------X--x

CLASS cell -X

BIND c line_clear "clear one full row"

CMD line_clear
 ATOMIC
  xXXXXXXXXXX x!!!!!!!!!! [lastmatch]

  REPEAT
   ATOMIC 1 cell 2 cell 3 cell 4 cell 5 cell 6 cell 7 cell 8 cell 9 cell 0 cell
    1234567890 !!!!!!!!!!
    !!!!!!!!!! 1234567890

  !!!!!!!!!! ----------
